result.summary: Found 3 issues: content is cut off at the right edge of the horizontal scroll section, restaurant name text is truncated, and there is inconsistent heart icon styling between cards.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section cuts off the third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the edge of the screen, with the image and text both truncated abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial preview affordance (fade/gradient edge) or ensure card widths and spacing allow a cleaner peek of the next item to indicate scrollability.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis, making it look like a text/rendering error rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis (...) or reduce font size dynamically to indicate the text is intentionally shortened.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon has inconsistent background styling — white circle on the ramen bar image but a dark circle on the pizza image below, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon background style (e.g., consistent semi-transparent dark or white circle) across all promotional cards.
